<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd

# Read input file
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv')

# Identify indicator columns (all except city_id, city_name, year)
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Compute missingness for each indicator
missing_report = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
    total_count = len(df)
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_count if total_count > 0 else 0.0
    kept = missing_rate <= 0.30
    missing_report.append({
        'indicator': col,
        'missing_count': int(missing_count),
        'missing_rate': missing_rate,
        'kept': kept
    })

# Create missingness report DataFrame
missing_df = pd.DataFrame(missing_report)

# Write missingness report
missing_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False)

# Select kept indicators
kept_indicators = [row['indicator'] for row in missing_report if row['kept']]

# Create selected matrix with city_id, city_name, year and only kept indicators
selected_df = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + kept_indicators]

# Write selected matrix
selected_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv', index=False)
</solution_file>
